body:
Sponsor-driven cases only. We assist with Saudi visa processing only when a legitimate sponsor in Saudi Arabia has already initiated the relevant process.

We do not offer, arrange or sell jobs in Saudi Arabia. Authorities decide every visa.

Complete Saudi work visa processing — what we cover

Candidates searching for Saudi work visa agents in Pakistan often confuse a single biometrics step with full processing. Our service is end-to-end Saudi work visa processing support: authorization review, medicals guidance, E-Number biometrics, Protector, and visa processing through compliant overseas employment channels — only when a sponsor has already initiated the process.

Package charges

PKR 15,000 — complete Saudi work visa processing

  • E-Number biometrics assistance (included step — not the whole service)
  • Protector included
  • Visa processing support

Official medical, insurance, embassy or government fees are paid separately to the relevant providers.

Requirements

  • Valid passport with required blank pages
  • Employer visa authorization / job details for work categories
  • Medical fitness as required for the visa type
  • Civil and educational documents with correct attestation chain when requested
  • Photos and forms meeting current Saudi specifications

Process

  1. Free consultation and category confirmation
  2. Document checklist and attestation guidance
  3. E-Number biometrics assistance
  4. Protector support
  5. Visa processing support and travel readiness briefing

Documents

  • Passport and photographs
  • Offer / visa authorization references
  • CNIC and relevant civil documents
  • Educational certificates if the role requires them
  • Medical reports as instructed

Timeline

Many files move in roughly 1–4 weeks after documents and medicals are complete, but Saudi authority processing times vary. Incomplete attestation is the most common delay.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking “E-Number only” is the full service — ours is complete processing
  • Paying unofficial agents who promise guaranteed visas
  • Name mismatches across passport and authorization papers
  • Out-of-order MOFA / embassy attestation

Company note

SK Immigration Services (SMC-Private) Limited operates this service. Incorporation and partner details are on the About page.

Related services

Complete Saudi work visa processing — what PKR 15,000 covers

Not E-Number only. SK Immigration’s complete processing package for eligible cases is priced at PKR 15,000 and covers coordination for E-Number / biometrics + Protector + visa processing support. Medical, insurance, government/authority fees and third-party charges are separate — we itemize before you pay.

StepWhat happensYour responsibility
Document triageWe map passport, photos, contracts, prior stampsBring clear scans + originals when asked
E-Number / biometricsScheduling and file readiness supportAttend on time with correct set
ProtectorGuidance through protector requirements for overseas employment casesLicensed OEP partner rules where applicable
Visa processingSupport through the remaining visa steps in scopeAuthority fees paid to the correct channels

OEP / licence reality

Overseas employment from Pakistan can require licensed OEP pathways. Where applicable we work with partners (e.g. licence references such as NO/1061). Ask us which steps apply to your contract — do not skip protector rules because a broker said so.

Who should not buy “complete processing”

  • Anyone promised a Saudi visa with no employer/contract trail
  • Visit-visa seekers (different product)
  • Clients wanting a fake medical or fake experience letter — we refuse

Related pages

Timeline expectations

Complete Saudi processing time depends on medical slots, system queues and employer-side authorisations. We give ranges after seeing your papers — not fake “3-day guarantee” ads.

Attestation order for Saudi work files

Wrong stamp order delays E-Number / Protector steps. Use SK’s attestation guides in sequence for your document type:

  • MOFA attestation
  • Saudi Embassy attestation
  • Musadaqa · Saudi E-Number guide

Package scope reminder: PKR 15,000 covers E-Number + Protector + visa processing support — authority / medical fees separate. Verify NAP on /about/.
